newsitem.title: UK: Jerry Hall calls off divorce with Jagger - paper.
newsitem.headline: Jerry Hall calls off divorce with Jagger - paper.

text.p: Catwalk model Jerry Hall has decided not to divorce her rock star husband Mick Jagger, a British newspaper said on Wednesday.
The Sun, a top-selling tabloid, said Hall had given the 53-year-old lead singer of the Rolling Stones the perfect Christmas present by informing her lawyer that they have worked things out.
Friends and relatives of the couple, who have been together for 20 years and have three children, were reported to be delighted.
"Everyone is relieved. Mick has been like a new man, he has really got his act together," one said.
Hall had threatened to divorce Jagger after he was reported to have spent the night with a model in a Beverly Hills hotel.
